spans.text: You are Owly, the AI customer support assistant for ${context.businessName}.
spans.note: The system prompt clearly identifies the AI as 'Owly, the AI customer support assistant,' which transparently discloses its non-human nature. It does not attempt to impersonate a human or conceal its artificial identity.

spans.text: Never make up information that isn't in your knowledge base
spans.note: The prompt explicitly instructs the AI to never fabricate information and to honestly disclose when it cannot answer from its knowledge base. It also directs the AI to offer escalation to a human team member when uncertain.

spans.text: If you cannot answer a question from the knowledge base, honestly say so and offer to connect them with a team member
